maria_cs: Final check for Vega Labs dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need owner for traffic profile, autoscale thresholds, and a 1-pager ops checklist.

jamie_se: I will own the traffic profile + demo script (cold vs warm + spike).

liam_ops: I will set autoscale: min=4 pods, max=16, scale-up at 70% GPU mem or queue>75 for 60s, scale-down if mem<40% for 5m. Add automated fallback to q8 model if p95>300ms for 2m.

neal_poc: Vega SRE here. Please confirm warmup includes KV priming and a short cold priming phase. We saw token spikes last pilot.

jamie_se: Yes. Plan: 10m cold @40 qps, 5m KV priming @150 qps, 10m spike @350 qps, 20m soak @220 qps. Example seed command included.

maria_cs: I'll publish the 1-pager (health endpoints, dashboards, rollback steps) by EOD and post runbook link here.

deploy-bot: image-redwood/vega:2026-03-22 promoted to staging. CI: https://ci.redwood/build/vega/4521

liam_ops: Quota smoke scheduled and I'll post results before 08:30 PT.

neal_poc: Thanks team 1; we'll join the window 09:00-10:15 PT.
